entries.clue: Vain dandy of studied poses, the affected aesthete mocked in the comedy Patience
Harbour town at the far end of the line from Paddington, in an 1879 title
Cider county running from Exmoor down to the English Channel
Sleeveless apron frock, and the name of the warship in an 1878 comic opera
Sovereign's ceremonial bodyguards, whose name begins an 1888 title ending 'of the Guard'
Low blur of many soft voices, all that breaks the general quiet
Small sum in coppers exacted for keeping something out too long
Academic periodical appearing in numbered parts, stocked for research
City lending its name to an early Pearmain, red and ripe by September
Sticky rise inside an apple tree in spring, lifting the rind for the knife
